mapper.select: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{email}, #{online}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, email = EXCLUDED.email, online = EXCLUDED.online, last_login_at = EXCLUDED.last_login_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = EXCLUDED.version WHERE users.version = COALESCE(#{expectedVersion}, users.version) RETURNING id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, version

INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{playerId}, #{defaultName}, '', 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id RETURNING id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, version
mapper.sql: (#{record.playerId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{record.fields.name}, ''), CONCAT('player-', #{record.playerId})), COALESCE(#{record.fields.email}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{record.fields.online}, '')::INTEGER, 0), to_timestamp(NULLIF(#{record.fields.last_login_at}, '')::BIGINT / 1000.0), to_timestamp(NULLIF(#{record.fields.updated_at}, '')::BIGINT / 1000.0), CAST(#{record.newVersion} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{record.expectedVersion} AS INTEGER))
mapper.select:
WITH input(id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, new_version, expected_version) AS ( VALUES
), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, version) SELECT id, name, email, online, last_login_at, updated_at, new_version FROM input ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, email = EXCLUDED.email, online = EXCLUDED.online, last_login_at = EXCLUDED.last_login_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, version = EXCLUDED.version WHERE users.version = ( SELECT expected_version FROM input WHERE input.id = users.id ) RETURNING id ) SELECT id FROM upserted
